dialogues.jp: 「ウエー、やっと終わった〜」
dialogues.en: "I finished my work, Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "I finished my work, Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生に頼まれた仕事が、ようやくひと段落し
た。
dialogues.en: I said, while looking at the computer screen.
dialogues.text: I said, while looking at the computer screen.

dialogues.jp:
結局、雑用というか、なんというか、そういう
仕事だ。
dialogues.en: "Sempai, it's me, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Sempai, it's me, Miharu."

dialogues.jp:
なんてことを言われたが、はたして本当に役に
立つのやら……。
dialogues.en: That voice...
dialogues.text: That voice...

dialogues.jp: がらりと入り口のドアが開く。
dialogues.en: "Miharu, are you okay now?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu, are you okay now?"

dialogues.jp: 「先生、仕事、終わりましたから」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about it. I'm just glad you're all right."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about it. I'm just glad you're all right."

dialogues.jp:
どうせ、暦先生だろうと、俺はパソコン画面か
ら目を離すことなく、答える。
dialogues.en: I feel relieved to see Miharu looking fine.
dialogues.text: I feel relieved to see Miharu looking fine.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、美春です〜」
dialogues.en: "I'm much better now. I also got my spring wound up."
dialogues.text: "I'm much better now. I also got my spring wound up."

dialogues.jp: その声は……。
dialogues.en: Then Miharu raises her fist in the air.
dialogues.text: Then Miharu raises her fist in the air.

dialogues.jp: 「美春、もういいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Take it easy. Would you like a coffee?"
dialogues.text: "Take it easy. Would you like a coffee?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい。何とか……。充分休みましたし。心配
　かけてごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'll do it."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'll do it."

dialogues.jp:
美春の元気な顔を見て、ようやく安心できた気
がする。
dialogues.en: "That's okay."
dialogues.text: "That's okay."

dialogues.jp: 美春がそう言って、ガッツポーズを取る。
dialogues.en: I sit Miharu on the chair, and get two cups ready.
dialogues.text: I sit Miharu on the chair, and get two cups ready.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、病み上がりなんだから座っとけよ。そう
　だ、コーヒー飲むか？」
dialogues.en: I pour hot water into the cups.
dialogues.text: I pour hot water into the cups.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そういうのは、美春がやりますよぉ」
dialogues.en: "I never thought I'd collapse during class."
dialogues.text: "I never thought I'd collapse during class."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、美春を椅子に座らせて、紙コップをふた
つ用意する。
dialogues.en:
It must've have been one of the blackouts she talked about.
I think it was a pretty nasty one this time.
dialogues.text:
It must've have been one of the blackouts she talked about.
I think it was a pretty nasty one this time.

dialogues.jp:
紙コップに熱い湯が注がれ、コーヒーのかけら
が、みるみるうちに溶けていく。
dialogues.en: "Listen, Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "Listen, Miharu..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いやー、失敗失敗。まさか、授業中に倒れる
　とは思いませんでしたよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp:
たぶん、前に言ってた“記憶が飛ぶ”ってヤツ
のひどいバージョンに陥ったんだろうな。
dialogues.en: Holding her cup, Miharu looks straight at me.
dialogues.text: Holding her cup, Miharu looks straight at me.

dialogues.jp: 「それでさ、美春……」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking... Maybe we should stop looking for your
memories."
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking... Maybe we should stop looking for your
memories."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんですか？　先輩」
dialogues.en: "Why? Sempai, what do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Why? Sempai, what do you mean?"

dialogues.jp:
美春は、俺の手からコーヒーを受け取りながら、
その真っ直ぐな目で俺を見る。
dialogues.en: "I don't want to see you suffer any more, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "I don't want to see you suffer any more, Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え、先輩。それ、どういうことです？」
美春が立ち上がり、口を挟もうとする。
dialogues.en: Miharu gets up and tries to interrupt.
dialogues.text: Miharu gets up and tries to interrupt.

dialogues.jp: が、それをやめ、そのまま立ちつくす。
dialogues.en: But she gives up. She keeps standing.
dialogues.text: But she gives up. She keeps standing.

dialogues.jp:
「暦先生に言われたんだ。…って、前から言わ
　れてるんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei warned me again."
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei warned me again."

dialogues.jp:
「記憶を思い出したって、それは美春の身体に
　負担をかけるんだって。確実に命を縮めるか
　らだって」
dialogues.en:
"She said bringing your memories back is bad for you, and it
will kill you."
dialogues.text:
"She said bringing your memories back is bad for you, and it
will kill you."

dialogues.jp:
「俺は、ずーっと美春と一緒にいられるものだ
　と思いこんでた。いつまでも、一緒に楽しく
　過ごせるはずだと信じていた」
dialogues.en:
"I thought I was going to be able to stay with you
forever..."
dialogues.text:
"I thought I was going to be able to stay with you
forever..."

dialogues.jp:
「けど、よく考えたら、そんなことないんだよ
　な。美春との別れは、そんなに遠くはないん
　だ……」
dialogues.en:
"But then I found that it's not like that. We might have to
say good bye to each other sooner than we think."
dialogues.text:
"But then I found that it's not like that. We might have to
say good bye to each other sooner than we think."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先生、そんなこと言ってたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Did Koyomi-sensei say that?"
dialogues.text: "Did Koyomi-sensei say that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことって、美春自身のことだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. It's about you, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. It's about you, Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は、自分の寿命が短いことは知っていま
　すよ。それは目が覚めた時から、わかってた
　ことですもん」
dialogues.en:
"I know my lifespan is short. I've known it since I woke
up."
dialogues.text:
"I know my lifespan is short. I've known it since I woke
up."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そんな軽く言うなよ。人間にたとえると死ん
　じゃうのと同じだろ？　怖くないのか」
dialogues.en:
"You ought to be more serious about this. We're talking
about your death! Aren't you afraid of dying?"
dialogues.text:
"You ought to be more serious about this. We're talking
about your death! Aren't you afraid of dying?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あはは、そうですね。でも、美春は変なとこ
　ろで機械的に出来てまして。純粋な生命体で
　はないですから」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. Sometimes I think so robotically. After all, I'm
not a pure life form."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. Sometimes I think so robotically. After all, I'm
not a pure life form."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「けど、俺は……せっかく美春を好きになって、
　それで、これからいろんなことをするんだと
　思ってたのに……」
dialogues.en:
"I finally come to realize my true feelings for you. I was
thinking of us doing so many things together."
dialogues.text:
"I finally come to realize my true feelings for you. I was
thinking of us doing so many things together."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それは、美春も同じです……。けど、最初か
　ら決まっていたことだから」
dialogues.en: "Me too. But I'm destined to live this way."
dialogues.text: "Me too. But I'm destined to live this way."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春と一緒にいろんなとこに遊びに行ったり、
　いろんなモノ食べたり、ずーっとおしゃべり
　したり……」
dialogues.en:
"We could go to a lot of places, eat a lot of stuff and talk
all day long together."
dialogues.text:
"We could go to a lot of places, eat a lot of stuff and talk
all day long together."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春もそう強く願ってました」
dialogues.en: "I think so too."
dialogues.text: "I think so too."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「だったら……」
dialogues.en: "Then why?"
dialogues.text: "Then why?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だからです。美春は、充実した毎日を送りた
　いと思ってます。先輩とだけじゃなく、さっ
　ちんや洋子や……音夢先輩とも」
dialogues.en:
"That's why I want to lead a full life every day with you,
with Sacchin, Yoko... and Nemu-sempai."
dialogues.text:
"That's why I want to lead a full life every day with you,
with Sacchin, Yoko... and Nemu-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「だからこそ、思い出探しはやめたくないです」
dialogues.en:
"I don't want to stop looking for my memories. I don't care
about whether I can live a long life or not. I just want to
live for people, not just for myself."
dialogues.text:
"I don't want to stop looking for my memories. I don't care
about whether I can live a long life or not. I just want to
live for people, not just for myself."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "Miharu..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は自分のために、ほんの少し長生きする
　ことよりも、たくさんの人達のために生きた
　いんです」
dialogues.en:
"I know I'm being selfish, considering all the troubles I've
caused you guys."
dialogues.text:
"I know I'm being selfish, considering all the troubles I've
caused you guys."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en:
"I want to be with you as long as possible, Miharu. I just
hate to see you suffer."
dialogues.text:
"I want to be with you as long as possible, Miharu. I just
hate to see you suffer."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春はわがままだと思います……。先輩や先
　生にこれだけ迷惑をかけて」
dialogues.en: "I want to live my life for the people who care about me."
dialogues.text: "I want to live my life for the people who care about me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「俺は少しでも美春と長くいたい。それに、苦
　しんでいる姿も見たくないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"You still don't get it. You're only thinking about yourself
because you know how much I care about you, Miharu!"
dialogues.text:
"You still don't get it. You're only thinking about yourself
because you know how much I care about you, Miharu!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「わがままだよ……。わがまま過ぎるよ。俺が
　どれだけ美春のことを想っているか知ってる
　くせに」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, sempai..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, sempai..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい、先輩……」
dialogues.en:
"But... I know that's who you are, and that's who I fell in
love with."
dialogues.text:
"But... I know that's who you are, and that's who I fell in
love with."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、俺は美春のそういうところを好きになっ
　たんだよな……」
dialogues.en: "I know what I am and who I am."
dialogues.text: "I know what I am and who I am."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ひとつだけ、約束してくれ」
dialogues.en: "Promise me one thing."
dialogues.text: "Promise me one thing."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「最期は、美春と一緒に居たい」
dialogues.en: "I want to be with you when you have to go."
dialogues.text: "I want to be with you when you have to go."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「約束です。美春も最期は先輩と一緒に居たい
　ですから」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I promise. I want to be with you as well in the last
chapter of my life."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I promise. I want to be with you as well in the last
chapter of my life."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "Miharu..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は椅子から立ち上がり、美春のそばに寄る。
dialogues.en: I stand up and come close to Miharu.
dialogues.text: I stand up and come close to Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「止まるのは怖くないように作ってあるけれど、
　別れが寂しくないようには作ってないみたい
　ですから……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not built to be afraid when I get shut down, but not
when I miss somebody."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not built to be afraid when I get shut down, but not
when I miss somebody."

dialogues.jp:
覗き込んだ美春の目には、ゆらゆらと揺れる俺
が映っていた。
dialogues.en: I can see myself reflected in her tearful eyes.
dialogues.text: I can see myself reflected in her tearful eyes.

dialogues.jp:
瞳を潤ませた美春の首筋に手を添え、そっと引
き寄せる。
dialogues.en: I put my hand on the nape of her neck and pull her up to me.
dialogues.text: I put my hand on the nape of her neck and pull her up to me.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Sempai..."
dialogues.text: "Sempai..."

dialogues.jp:
美春が目を閉じると、｛まぶた／瞼｝から溢れた涙がひと筋、
つーっと流れ落ちた。
dialogues.en:
When she closes her eyes, a tear runs straight down her
face.
dialogues.text:
When she closes her eyes, a tear runs straight down her
face.

dialogues.jp:
それを親指で拭いながら、俺は美春にキスをし
た。
dialogues.en: I wipe it off her face with my thumb and kiss her.
dialogues.text: I wipe it off her face with my thumb and kiss her.

dialogues.jp: 思った以上に柔らかく、冷たかった。
dialogues.en: Her lips feel more gentle and colder than I'd thought.
dialogues.text: Her lips feel more gentle and colder than I'd thought.

dialogues.jp: けれど、彼女の吐息は温かかった。
dialogues.en: Her breath feels warm.
dialogues.text: Her breath feels warm.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、そのまま美春を抱き寄せ、キスを続ける。
dialogues.en: I pull her towards me and keep kissing her.
dialogues.text: I pull her towards me and keep kissing her.

dialogues.jp: ｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な美春の身体が、俺にぴたりと密着する。
dialogues.en: Her slender body sticks to me.
dialogues.text: Her slender body sticks to me.

dialogues.jp:
キスはただ、重ねるだけの他愛もないものだっ
たけれど、長く長く重ねていた。
dialogues.en:
Kissing is just the simple act of putting our lips together.
But we keep kissing for so long.
dialogues.text:
Kissing is just the simple act of putting our lips together.
But we keep kissing for so long.

dialogues.jp:
そして、どれだけの時間が過ぎたかわからない
けれど、（５分だったのか、１時間だったのか）
互いに唇を離した。
dialogues.en:
I don't know how long we were kissing each other (could have
been 5 minutes or an hour), but we finally let go of each
other's lips.
dialogues.text:
I don't know how long we were kissing each other (could have
been 5 minutes or an hour), but we finally let go of each
other's lips.

dialogues.jp:
「少しくらい、心配かけたっていいさ。美春が、
　自分の思うように生きてくれるのが、一番嬉
　しいんだから」
dialogues.en:
"You can make me worry a little bit. I'm happy as long as
you live your life with no regret."
dialogues.text:
"You can make me worry a little bit. I'm happy as long as
you live your life with no regret."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は、先輩の――そう言ってくれるところ
　が大好きです」
dialogues.en: "That means a lot to me. That's why I love you."
dialogues.text: "That means a lot to me. That's why I love you."

dialogues.jp: 彼女はそう言って笑った。
dialogues.en: She smiles.
dialogues.text: She smiles.

dialogues.en: "Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "Miharu..."

dialogues.jp:
もう一度、美春のことを抱きしめたくて、手を
伸ばす。
dialogues.en: I want to hold Miharu again, so I reach out to her.
dialogues.text: I want to hold Miharu again, so I reach out to her.

dialogues.jp: ――がらり
dialogues.en: The door opens.
dialogues.text: The door opens.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「お疲れ〜。あれ、天枷。もういいのかい？」
dialogues.en: "Hello. Oh, hi, Amakase! Are you okay now?"
dialogues.text: "Hello. Oh, hi, Amakase! Are you okay now?"

dialogues.jp:
背後から、場にそぐわない、おちゃらけた声が
聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: And I hear some out-of-place voices from behind her.
dialogues.text: And I hear some out-of-place voices from behind her.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、白河先生。はい、もうすっかり」
dialogues.en: "Uh, yes. Shirakawa-sensei... I feel much better now."
dialogues.text: "Uh, yes. Shirakawa-sensei... I feel much better now."

dialogues.jp:
……絶妙のタイミングで、邪魔をする人だなぁ。
もしかして、ずっと扉の向こうで聞いてた？
dialogues.en: Gee, thanks for showing up at such a bad time...
dialogues.text: Gee, thanks for showing up at such a bad time...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉〜、頼んでた仕事は？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura. Are you done with the work I asked you to do?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura. Are you done with the work I asked you to do?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「終わりましたよ、ちゃんと」
dialogues.en: "Yes, absolutely."
dialogues.text: "Yes, absolutely."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「おや、えらい不機嫌だね。何かあったの？」
dialogues.en: "What's up? You look very upset."
dialogues.text: "What's up? You look very upset."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ぶぇつにぃ、何でもないですよ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing..."
dialogues.text: "Nothing..."

dialogues.jp: ぷいと横を向く俺。
dialogues.en: I just look away.
dialogues.text: I just look away.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あははは……」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……天枷まで」
dialogues.en: "Amakase..."
dialogues.text: "Amakase..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうだ。朝倉のためにさぁ、仕事持って
　きてあげたよ。他の先生も乗り気でさぁ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I brought you some more work to do. Other teachers like
this idea."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I brought you some more work to do. Other teachers like
this idea."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、俺の前にどさりとプリントの束を
置く。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei drops a pile of paper on the desk in front of
me.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei drops a pile of paper on the desk in front of
me.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あはは。朝倉が暇してるって伝えたらさぁ、
　みんな喜んで仕事を作ってくれて」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. I told them that you were just goofing around. So
they got me these for you to do."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. I told them that you were just goofing around. So
they got me these for you to do."

dialogues.jp: この人は、人間の皮を被った悪鬼ですな。
dialogues.en: She must be a devil pretending to be a human.
dialogues.text: She must be a devil pretending to be a human.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春も手伝ってあげますよ。そしたら、すぐ
　に終わりますよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll help you. we can do it quicker that way."
dialogues.text: "I'll help you. we can do it quicker that way."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、それいいねぇ」
dialogues.en: "That's a good idea."
dialogues.text: "That's a good idea."

dialogues.jp:
先生は面白そうにクスクスと笑っている。もし
かしてこの人、みんなから中間マージンとか、
徴収してんじゃないだろうな。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei chuckles. Is she getting a profit margin from
other teachers' work?
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei chuckles. Is she getting a profit margin from
other teachers' work?

dialogues.jp: うーむ、やりかねんぞ、この人なら。
dialogues.en: She's definitely getting something.
dialogues.text: She's definitely getting something.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いな美春」
dialogues.en: "Thanks, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Thanks, Miharu."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、美春にプリントを分けて渡す。
dialogues.en: I hand Miharu some piles of paper.
dialogues.text: I hand Miharu some piles of paper.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、こういうのも楽しいからいいですよ」
dialogues.en: "This is going to be fun."
dialogues.text: "This is going to be fun."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いやぁ、愛の力は偉大だねぇ。絆を深めあっ
　た恋人同士には敵わないね」
dialogues.en: "Love conquers all. No one can beat a couple in love."
dialogues.text: "Love conquers all. No one can beat a couple in love."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あれ、なにふたりとも真っ赤な顔してるの？
　ちょっとやめてよ〜、こんなとこで〜」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm? How come both of you are blushing? Wait a minute! Were
you guys doing something naughty in my room?"
dialogues.text:
"Hmm? How come both of you are blushing? Wait a minute! Were
you guys doing something naughty in my room?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「し、してません〜っ！　そんなこと、絶対し
　てませぇん！　まだキスだけですっ！」
dialogues.en: "No... No way! We were only kissing! That's it!"
dialogues.text: "No... No way! We were only kissing! That's it!"

dialogues.jp: 準備室の時が、ちょっとだけ止まった。
dialogues.en: There's an awkward pause in the room.
dialogues.text: There's an awkward pause in the room.

dialogues.jp: ◆最期は美春と一緒に◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
思い出探しはもうやめにしないか？　元気になっ
た美春に俺はそう切り出した。
dialogues.en: I finished the work Koyomi-sensei asked to do.
dialogues.text: I finished the work Koyomi-sensei asked to do.

dialogues.jp:
でも、美春は思い出探しはやめたくないと言う。
美春を大切に思ってくれている人達のために一
生懸命生きたいと。
dialogues.en: In the end, the work is more like her office chores.
dialogues.text: In the end, the work is more like her office chores.

dialogues.jp:
結局、俺は美春の信念に負けてしまう。だから
俺と美春はひとつだけ約束をした。
dialogues.en: "It's the experience that counts."
dialogues.text: "It's the experience that counts."

dialogues.jp: 最期は、一緒に居たい。
dialogues.en: But I'm not sure if this work counts.
dialogues.text: But I'm not sure if this work counts.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺と美春ははじめてのキスをした。
dialogues.en: The door opens.
dialogues.text: The door opens.
